title: Alder Bay parcel lockers

sentences.text: Here is your three-minute briefing on Alder Bay's parcel locker trial.
Alder Bay is testing parcel lockers at its public library.
Residents enter a collection code to open the assigned locker.
Library staff place parcels inside and send each code directly.
The town will review missed collections before deciding whether to continue.
Staff also record resident feedback during the trial period.
The main takeaway is that the town will decide after reviewing missed collections and resident feedback.

read_takeaway: The next decision depends on what the trial records.
